MNF_LANG#0.quote: The official language of the state is Meitei (also known as Manipuri).

MNF_AREA#0.quote: The total area covered by the state is 22,327 km2 (8,621 sq mi).

MNF_AIR#0.quote: Bir Tikendrajit International Airport is situated in the capital Imphal which connects direct flights from Imphal to Kolkata, Guwahati, New Delhi, Bangalore and Agartala.

MNF_CAP#0.quote: The capital city of Manipur, Imphal , serves as the gateway to this enchanting state.

MNF_RAIN#0.quote: The state receives an average annual rainfall of 1,467.5 mm (57.78 in) between April and mid-October.

MNF_RAIN#1.quote: The maximum temperature in the summer months is 32 °C (90 °F).

MNF_RAIN#2.quote: This northeastern corner of India enjoys a generally amiable climate, though the winters can be cool.

MNF_SANGAI#0.quote: The Sangai Festival, held in November, showcases the state's rich cultural heritage through dance, music, and traditional sports.

MNF_NINGOL#0.quote: Held on 9 November, this is a social festival of the Meitei people of Manipur where married women (Ningol) are invited (Chakouba, literally calling to a meal; for dinner or lunch) to a feast at their parental house accompanied by their children.

MNF_OTHER#0.quote: The festivals of Manipur are Lui-ngai-ni Ningol Chakouba, Shirui Lily festival, Yaoshang, Gan-ngai, Chumpha, Cheiraoba, Kang and Heikru Hidongba, as well as the broader religious festivals Eid-Ul-Fitr, Eid-Ul-Adha and Christmas.

MNF_HAND#0.quote: Rule one is: eat with your right hand only .

MNR_RAIL#0.quote: Manipur has one operational railway station, Jiribam.

MNR_RAIL#1.quote: National Highway 53 (India) connects Manipur with another railway station at Silchar in Assam, which is 269 km (167 mi) away from Imphal.

MNR_ROAD#0.quote: National Highway NH-39 links Manipur with the rest of the country through the railway stations at Dimapur in Nagaland at a distance of 215 km (134 mi) from Imphal.

MLF_AREA#0.quote: Meghalaya covers an area of approximately 22,429 square kilometres

MLF_AIR#0.quote: State capital Shillong has an airport at Umroi 30 kilometres (19 mi) from Shillong on the Guwahati-Shillong highway.

MLF_RAIN#0.quote: With the average annual rainfall as high as 12,000 mm (470 in) in some areas, Meghalaya is the wettest place on Earth.

MLR_RAIL#1.quote: Meghalaya has a railhead at Mendipathar and regular train service connecting Mendipathar in Meghalaya and Guwahati in Assam, has started on 30 November 2014.

MZF_CAP#0.quote: Mizoram's airport is at the capital city of Aizawl.

MZF_LANG#0.quote: Mizo and English are the official languages of the state.

MZF_AREA#0.quote: Mizoram covers 21,081 square kilometres (8,139 sq mi), of which 84.53% is forested, making it the 4th-most forested state in India.

MZF_SUM#0.quote: Mizoram has a humid, subtropical climate with temperate to warm summers ranging from 20 to 30 °C (68 to 86 °F).

MZF_WIN#0.quote: Winters experience a cool and arid ambiance in a temperature range of 10 to 20 °C (50 to 68 °F).

MZF_MON#0.quote: The region is influenced by monsoons, raining heavily from June to September which sustains high humidity and lush forestry.

MZF_CHAP#0.quote: The Chapchar Kut, celebrated in February-March, marks the onset of spring with colorful dance performances and traditional rituals.

NLF_CAP#0.quote: Its capital city is Kohima and its largest city is the twin Chümoukedima–Dimapur.

NLF_LANG#0.quote: The majority of the population in the state speaks English, which is the official language of the state.

NLF_AREA#0.quote: The state has an area of 16,579 square kilometres (6,401 sq mi)

NLF_RAIN#0.quote: Annual rainfall averages around 1,800–2,500 millimetres (70–100 in), concentrated in the months of May to September.

NLF_WIN#0.quote: In winter, temperatures do not generally drop below 4 °C (39 °F), but frost is common at high elevations.

NLF_HORN#0.quote: Hornbill Festival is an annual festival celebrated from 1 to 10 of December in the Northeastern Indian state of Nagaland.

NLF_HORN#1.quote: Just 12 kms from Kohima, you can discover the Kisama Heritage Village, where the world-famous Hornbill Festival comes to life.

NLR_RAIL#0.quote: Its main railway station is the second busiest station in Northeast India.

NLR_KOHIMA#0.quote: The Battle of Kohima about 77 km from Dimapur is considered the turning point for the Japanese retreat from Southeast Asia.

TRF_CAP#0.quote: Tripura is divided into eight districts and 23 sub-divisions, where Agartala is the capital and the largest city in the state.

TRF_LANG#0.quote: Bengali, Kokborok, and English are the state's official languages.

TRF_AREA#0.quote: The third-smallest state in the country, it covers 10,491 km2 (4,051 sq mi)

TRF_AIR#0.quote: Maharaja Bir Bikram Airport, located 12 km northwest of Agartala at Singerbhil, is the second busiest airport in northeast India after Guwahati.

TRF_SEASONS#0.quote: The four main seasons are winter, from December to February; pre-monsoon or summer, from March to April; monsoon, from May to September; and post-monsoon, from October to November.

TRF_SEASONS#1.quote: During the monsoon season, the south west monsoon brings heavy rains, which cause frequent floods.

TRF_FEST#1.quote: Some festivals represent confluence of different regional traditions, such as Ganga puja, Garia puja, Kharchi puja and Ker puja.
